content: Webpay return into SPA (derived from primary Transbank docs): the return_url receives a browser POST (GET in API 1.1+) from Webpay carrying token_ws/TBK_* params - a React SPA cannot be the direct target of that POST because the router only handles client-side navigation after the app has loaded. Recommended pattern: return_url points to a BACKEND endpoint (e.g. POST /api/payments/webpay/return) that inspects the 4 possible param flows, commits/validates via SDK, persists the order result, then 302-redirects the browser to a SPA route like /checkout/result?order=... where the page fetches the order state from the API. Community search added no primary-source SPA guide; this is the architecture implied by the official POST-to-return_url contract.
